case_number: CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. OF 2023 (ARISING OUT OF SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CRIMINAL) NO. 2044 OF 2022)
summary: Admissibility of police video evidence in criminal trial; Section 391 CrPC application for summoning officer-author of book granted by HC; SC reversed HC for lack of material basis; conjectures cannot trigger court witness summoning; victim testimony consistency pivotal; prosecution reliance on Section 161 statement over external video recording; crime scene verification procedure scrutinized.
final_judgment: Impugned High Court judgment allowing Section 391 application set aside; appeal allowed; trial court findings on evidence retention upheld.
